subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

My father __is wishing__ me to give all my time to studies now.
solution:
The correct answer is **'wishes'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Wishes",** this word is chosen as the best replacement for **"is wishing" **in the sentence because it more accurately expresses the ongoing nature of the father's desire for the speaker's focus on studies.
 
• The verb **"to wish" **means to feel or express a strong desire or hope for something.
 
 
• In the given sentence, the **father's desire is for the speaker to concentrate on their studies, is not temporary but permanent. **
 
 
 
• **"Is wishing" **imparts a sense of the present **continuous **tense, implying the action is happening right at this moment and is temporary, **"wishes" **is in the simple present tense.
 
• **The Simple Present Tense: **This tense is used when an action is happening right now, or when it happens regularly.
 
 
• When we say **"My father wishes me to give all my time to studies now," **we're implying that the father's wish is **not a temporary one**; instead, it is an ongoing or **a habitual desire. **
 
• This is a more accurate depiction of the situation based on the context.
 
 
 
• Thus, the improved sentence becomes: **"My father *wishes__* me to give all my time to studies now."**
